payload.title: Working with Age Ensembles
payload.description: This notebook demonstrates how to handle age ensembles in paleoclimate studies, focusing on quantifying chronological uncertainties. It uses the PyLiPD package to load data from LiPD files and illustrates how to create EnsembleSeries objects to represent dating uncertainty. The notebook also shows how to export ensemble information to Numpy arrays and Pandas DataFrames, and provides examples using data from LiPD and NOAA. The goal is to leverage age ensembles for more robust analysis of paleoclimate records.
